signals.source_text: Seraneth stood among the assembled thousands, feeling the Prime connection pulse with something that might have been pride.
Orange and purple and red painting clouds that drifted above pyramids and obelisks, above mountain peaks and forest canopies, above a world that had learned to sing.

As if something was interposing itself between sun and sky, blocking light that should still be reaching them.
Constructs that shouldn't exist within physical reality yet were manifesting anyway, forcing themselves into dimensions they didn't belong in.
The Aeon Keepers were sending their final briefing, compressed understanding flooding through dimensions into consciousness barely prepared to receive it:
Giants and Nephoretti stood together in the valley, surrounded by monuments to their cooperation, and watched their world die in darkness and descending shadow.
